title: PowerFix: Physics-Guided Iterative Repair for LLM-Assisted Power Converter Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.33712v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for automated engineering design. However, repairing power-converter designs that fail engineering validation remains challenging: the system must identify physical causes, locate responsible design variables, and resolve violations without compromising other constraints. We introduce PowerFix, a physics-guided iterative repair framework that converts validation failures into structured diagnoses and executable patches while preserving topology and design requirements. PowerDiagGraph links failed checks to possible physical causes and constrains repair routes. An LLM prioritizes these routes, while a deterministic compiler translates selected repairs into authorized field-level edits. translated_title: PowerFix：面向大语言模型辅助电源变换器设计的物理引导迭代修复方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正被越来越多地探索用于自动化工程设计。然而，修复未能通过工程验证的电源变换器设计仍然具有挑战性：系统必须识别物理层面的原因、定位相关的设计变量，并在不损害其他约束条件的前提下解决违规问题。我们提出了PowerFix，这是一个物理引导的迭代修复框架，它将验证失败转化为结构化的诊断结果和可执行的补丁，同时保留电路拓扑结构和设计要求。PowerDiagGraph将失败的检查项与可能的物理原因关联起来，并约束修复路径。大语言模型对这些修复路径进行优先级排序，而一个确定性编译器将选定的修复方案转化为经过授权的字段级编辑。候选方案在隔离的设计副本上进行验证，只有在所有必需的工程检查全部通过后才会被提交；验证失败还可以指导重新规划。在我们构建的96个反激变换器任务上（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: PowerFix提出了一个物理引导的迭代修复框架，通过将电源变换器设计的验证失败转化为结构化诊断与可执行补丁，结合LLM的修复路径排序和确定性编译器的字段级编辑，在不破坏电路拓扑和其他设计约束的前提下自动修复未通过工程验证的设计。
en_tdlr: PowerFix is a physics-guided iterative repair framework that converts failed engineering validations of power converter designs into structured diagnoses and executable patches, combining LLM-based repair route prioritization with a deterministic compiler to resolve violations without compromising topology or other design constraints.
